rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement (Rent Ordinance)
rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on the security deposit at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.

requires_unknown_facts: unit is fully or partially covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance

rules.key_value: annual interest on deposit, prorated at move-out

rules.title: California security deposit cap (AB 12)
rules.requirement: Since July 1, 2024, landlords generally may charge no more than one month's rent as a security deposit, furnished or unfurnished. Small landlords (two properties, four or fewer units total, owned by a natural person, family trust, or all-natural-person LLC) may charge up to two months. The deposit must be returned within 21 days of move-out with an itemized statement.
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.effective_date_note: Date stated on the Berkeley Rent Board page.

coverage.landlord_size_condition: owner of two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural-person members (two-month cap)

rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for qualifying small landlords)

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board page on security deposits: it describes the California AB 12 caps and return and deduction rules, and it states Berkeley's own interest requirement for covered units.
